industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The sector context matters here because the company's growth story is about the industry growing, not about the company taking share.
industry_snapshot.growth_bars_label: Specialty chemicals growth — actual vs projected
industry_snapshot.rationale: The industry section is rich with market-size and growth figures; a snapshot makes the scale and fragmentation scannable.
industry_snapshot.split_bar_note: SMEs hold 70–75% of the market; only a few Indian players compete globally.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The customer base is narrow. In FY15, FY16, and FY17, the top 10 customers accounted for around 59%, 57%, and 59% of revenue from operations, respectively.
pull_quotes.quote: We have not entered into any long term or definitive agreements with our customers.
pull_quotes.rationale: This single sentence from the DRHP crystallises the customer-concentration risk better than any paraphrase.

sidebars.body_markdown: The company is seeking a listing on the SME Platform of NSE, called NSE EMERGE [^drhp-p75]. The lead manager is Vivro Financial Services Private Limited [^drhp-p54]; the registrar is Link Intime India Private Limited [^drhp-p55]. The stated objects of the issue are: funding capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; general corporate purposes; and creating a public trading market for the equity shares [^drhp-p75]. The DRHP does not disclose the issue size, the price band, or whether any existing shareholder plans to sell shares in the offer.
sidebars.rationale: A sidebar neatly summarises the offer mechanics and the key undisclosed items, which are scattered across the prose.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The DRHP restates six periods: the six months ended September 30, 2017, and the five fiscal years ended March 31, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, and 2013.
tables.footnote: Sources: PAT and periods from the Restated Summary Statement of Profit and Loss [^drhp-p49]; operating cash flow from the Restated Summary Cash Flow Statement [^drhp-p50]; total assets from the Restated Summary Statement of Assets and Liabilities [^drhp-p175]; EPS from the ratios annexure [^drhp-p177].
tables.rationale: The six-period restated financials are the core of the report; a table lets the reader compare trends at a glance.
tables.title: Restated financial summary (₹ crore, except EPS)

tables.after_paragraph: Ownership is the governance story. The promoter group is led by 20 Microns Limited and three individuals: Chandresh S. Parikh and Atil C. Parikh, and Rajesh C. Parikh.
tables.footnote: Sources: promoter holding from page 155 [^drhp-p155]; promoter group holding from page 162 [^drhp-p162].
tables.rationale: The near-total promoter ownership is a defining governance fact; a compact table makes the concentration unmistakable.
tables.title: Pre-issue shareholding
